name: Aikagi 2 ~Nureta Kami ga Kawaku Mae ni~
original_name: あいかぎ2 ～濡れた髪が乾く前に～
source:
Shingo is a high school student, living alone. He sleeps with many girls ranging from his classmate girls to other school girls. But there is one girl, whom Shingo keeps a close relationship for several years. Her name is Shiori, his ex-homeroom teacher. He still doesn't love her, just a sex friend. One day, Shiori says to him, "What about living together at my house?" At first, he refuses it but he finally accepts it because he knows she just wants his body. But there is still one problem. That's Shiori's younger sister, Naho. She is his classmate and he hates her but doesn't know why. Naho is beautiful and liked by everyone. The more he sleeps with them, the more he understands them...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
独居的高中生慎悟是个风流成性的花花公子，从本校女同学到外校女生，与他上过床的女孩数不胜数。然而唯独前任班主任诗织，多年来一直与他维系着特殊的亲密关系——尽管在他眼里，两人之间并没有爱情，纯粹只是炮友。某天，诗织突然向他提议：“要不要搬来我家一起住？”慎悟起初一口回绝，但转念想到对方不过是贪图自己的身体，最终还是点头应允。然而同居生活还有一个棘手的问题：诗织的妹妹菜穗。身为慎悟同班同学的菜穗容貌出众、深受众人喜爱，唯独慎悟莫名看她不顺眼。随着与姐妹俩一次次肌肤相亲，慎悟也渐渐触及了她们不为人知的内心……
